course.title: Gele Tying
course.tagline: Tie beautiful gele styles for weddings and parties, from simple wraps to statement looks.

days.title: Welcome to Gele Tying
days.goal: By the end of today you can explain and practise: Your kit is aso-oke, sego, ankara gele fabric, pins, a mirror and a mannequin head.

video.title: How to Tie Sego Gele with Pleats

steps: Get your tools ready: aso-oke fabric, straight pins and mirror.
Watch the video. It explains the main point in simple steps: Aso-oke is the stiff fabric used for structured gele styles.
Your kit is aso-oke, sego, ankara gele fabric, pins, a mirror and a practice head. Go slowly. Practise on a model or a practice head.
Do the same move three times. Check your work in a mirror or a photo after each try.
Write down what went well, what was hard, and one thing to do better tomorrow.

quiz.q: What is the key point of today's lesson on welcome to gele tying?
options: You should rush through the technique to save time.
Aso-oke is the stiff fabric used for structured gele styles.
The best result comes from skipping the preparation step.
You never need to check your work until the very end.
quiz.explain: Aso-oke is the stiff fabric used for structured gele styles.

quiz.q: Which tool is most essential for welcome to gele tying?
options: clipper with guards
trimmer
aso-oke fabric
foil shaver
quiz.explain: The aso-oke fabric is the essential tool for this work.

quiz.q: What should you always do when working on welcome to gele tying?

never cut broken skin
check the client for cuts before starting
